author: Worcester County MA Daily Brief
title: 🚌 Worcester County Transportation Jobs - Multiple Openings Now Hiring - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Worcester County has a few solid driving and vehicle maintenance jobs open right now — great for anyone who likes being on the road or working with their hands.
Commercial Driver – Part Time Employer: AutoZone
Location: Milford, MA
Type: Part-time
No CDL needed! Drive company vehicles to deliver auto parts while helping customers find what they need. Includes competitive pay , store discounts, and a 401(k) with company match .
Commercial Driver – Full Time Employer: AutoZone
Location: Milford, MA
Type: Full-time
A steady full-time driving role with benefits, paid time off, and growth opportunities . You’ll deliver parts, support store operations, and keep customers rolling safely.
7D Van Driver for Childcare System Employer: Kids Unlimited Services, Inc.
Location: Charlton, MA
Type: Part-time
Transport children safely to and from childcare centers. $18/hour , 35 hours per week , and paid training . 7D license preferred, but training and reimbursement offered.
Bus Driver/Life Enrichment Assistant Employer: Alta Rehab (AdviniaCare Northbridge)
Location: Northbridge, MA
Type: Part-time
Drive residents to appointments and help with activities at a senior living community. CDL required. A good fit if you enjoy working with older adults and want a steady 20-hour week .
Diesel Technician Mechanic III – Entry Level Employer: Penske Truck Leasing
Location: Auburn, MA
Type: Full-time (2nd shift)
Earn $30.59/hr plus shift differential while learning from top techs. Maintain and repair a modern fleet with full training, benefits, and career growth.
